response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including geospatial data processing (GISCollective), low-latency systems (Dunnhumby), and distributed systems. However, his primary expertise lies in TypeScript, Node.js, and D, with limited recent exposure to C++ or Rust, which are critical for this role. His geospatial work is promising but lacks direct tie-ins to routing or navigation systems, and his experience with high-performance, fault-tolerant systems is not explicitly aligned with routing data pipelines.
strengths: Strong geospatial data processing experience (GISCollective, Green Map Association)
Proven ability to build scalable, low-latency systems (Dunnhumby, RIDE Capital)
Demonstrated expertise in distributed systems and CI/CD (RIDE Capital, Altom Consulting)
concerns: Limited recent experience with C++ or Rust, the primary technologies required for this role
No explicit mention of routing, navigation, or map data optimization in his work history
Geospatial projects (GISCollective) focus on data collection rather than routing/tile generation
